answer: The three words are derived from a 222 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the tide nonce is published only after close, the opal audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate wander derivation per key. That is 23 dollars per alias.
